title: Bioaccumulation in Aquatic Organisms: From One-Compartment Toxicokinetic Models to Real-World Complexity. Workshop material, University of Waterloo
description:
R scripts, curated datasets and teaching material for a half-day, hands-on workshop on toxicokinetic (TK) modelling of organic contaminants in aquatic invertebrates, held at the University of Waterloo on 12 November 2026.

Exercises: (1) the standard one-compartment TK model, (2) parent–metabolite models for biotransformation, (3a) two-compartment kinetics with receptor binding (elimination resistance), (3b) lipid partitioning, and (4) dietary uptake. All scripts fit models to published experimental data and estimate confidence intervals with the parameter-space explorer. They are an R re-implementation of the BYOM model TK-metabolism (BYOM v6.2 framework by Tjalling Jager).

See README.md for installation, instructions and data sources. Please cite the original studies when using the datasets.
